_about: The West of Middle-earth at the end of the Third Age on a 1024x1024 map: Lindon to Rhun, Forochel to Harad. Coordinates are miles east and north of Hobbiton, 2.3 miles per tile, north at the top. Built for MapFromPlan with every map editor feature: rules, banks, garrisons, rods, zones, templates, variables, neutral life and story events.
name: The War of the Ring
description: The West of Middle-earth at the end of the Third Age. The Shadow grows every turn the Dark Lord stands: neutral bands grow bolder, lost villages are fought over, and the Eye seeks the Ring hidden under the Misty Mountains. Carry it to Mount Doom, or conquer every capital.

stages.name: shadow
stages.message: The Shadow lengthens. Across the wild lands the bands that gather near their homes are stronger now, and the lost villages are fought for harder.

stages.name: darkness
stages.message: Darkness covers the land. The wild peoples gather in great strength. Strike at Dol Guldur, Minas Morgul or Isengard to push the Shadow back.

then.message: The Ring of Power has been found again. It lies hidden in the dark under the Misty Mountains, where a wretched creature hoards it. Whoever carries it into the fire of Mount Doom ends the Dark Lord forever. Or conquer every capital of your enemies.

then.objective: Destroy the Ring in Mount Doom, or capture every enemy capital.

then.message: The Ring falls into the Crack of Doom. The Dark Tower crumbles and its shadow passes from the world.

events.name: The Ring returns to its master

then.message: The One Ring is in the hand of its maker again. Darkness falls over all lands.
In a cave under the mountains, beside a cold lake, you find a plain gold ring. The Eye of the Dark Lord turns towards it at once.
The Balrog is gone and the halls of Khazad-dum lie open. A road runs under the Misty Mountains again.
Elrond calls the river. White horses of foam crash down upon your riders!
The trees close in. Old Man Willow wakes and his roots seize your army!
The heir of Isildur calls the Oathbreakers. 'We will fight, and then we will rest.'
Cold voices whisper: 'The way is shut.' The Dead come for you!
The beacons of Gondor are lit! Gondor calls for aid, and Rohan answers.

events.name: The last march of the Ents

then.message: Treebeard has made up his mind. The Ents march on Isengard, and the Huorns follow.
The dam of the Isen is broken. Water and green things flood the ring of Isengard. In the tower you find a dark crystal: through the palantir the Tower of Barad-dur looks back at you.
A dwarf kneels before the Lady of the Wood. She gives him three golden hairs, and the old grudge between Elves and Dwarves is healed.
Out of the East the Easterlings ride on Dale. King Brand and King Dain stand together before the gate.
The Southrons march north under the Red Eye, with great beasts of war among them.
Gwaihir the Windlord promises the Eagles' help. From the air they show you the land of Mordor.
Galadriel throws down the walls of Dol Guldur, and southern Mirkwood is made clean.
The Tower of Sorcery is taken and its pale light goes out.
The Black Gate of Mordor is cast down.
The Heart of the Mountain is home again. The Dwarves of every house take heart.
In the silver basin you see a great Eye, rimmed with fire, and far away a burning mountain.
Ruffians under a boss called Sharkey move into the Shire, cutting down trees and bullying hobbits.
Snow falls thick and stones roll from the heights. Caradhras will not let you pass easily.
Long tentacles slide out of the dark pool before the Doors of Durin. The Watcher stirs!
A foul smell, webs in the dark, and many eyes. Something old and hungry lives in this pass.
From the ruined watchtower of Amon Sul you can see far across Eriador. Black riders move on the road below.
The bells of Esgaroth ring: enemies on the lake shore! The Host of Erebor marches down to the lake.

Gulls cry over the Sundering Sea. The old isles keep their secrets: the watchtower of Himling, the werewolf isle of Tol Fuin, the peak of drowned Numenor, the corsairs' nest on Tolfalas and Osse's grotto in the southern sea. Whoever frees four of them may hear the Lord of Waters.

then.objective: Optional: free four of the five isles of the West, then Ulmo will answer.

then.message: The old watchtower of Himling is yours. From its top the whole western sea lies open.
The barrow of the werewolves is broken open and the pines of Tol Fuin fall silent.
On the summit of the Pillar of Heaven, the last of drowned Numenor, the hallow is opened. Far in the west a straight road seems to run on into the sky.
The corsairs' nest on Tolfalas burns. The Bay of Belfalas is safer for a while.
The sea rises and a great voice speaks out of the waves: the Lord of Waters has seen your deeds. His herald, the kraken of the deep, will fight for you.
Howls rise among the black pines. The werewolves of Tol Fuin come down to the shore!
The water boils around the drowned peak. The Kraken of the West is awake.
An old Sea-elf tells of a plain gold ring hidden under the Misty Mountains, and of a mountain of fire far in the east where it was made.
In the pirate king's chest on Gull Rock: a sea chart marking a grotto on the Isle of Osse, and a heavy gold ring.
Osse, servant of the Lord of Waters, does not love sailors. A storm breaks over your ships!
Deep in the grotto lie the gifts that drowned sailors left to Osse. The storms around the isle die down.
